### Added

- (flux-react) [Show each resource card's manifest as YAML](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2744) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In the Flux UI's details panel, every resource card has a `View YAML` button that opens the resource's manifest read-only, with `Copy manifest`. The agent and workflow manifest dialogs look and copy the same way.
- (gs) [Show worker CPU and memory capacity of clusters](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2736) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — A cluster's About card shows `Worker capacity`, e.g. `4 nodes · 32 vCPUs · 128 GiB RAM`, and the Clusters table has optional, sortable `Worker CPU` and `Worker memory` columns.
- (plans) [Hive merges Plans, Roadmap and the magazine](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2743) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Plans, Roadmap and the product magazine become one sidebar entry, Hive, with the tabs Now, History, Roadmap, Plans and Knowledge and a shared team selector and search. Old links redirect. Disabled by default.

### Changed

- (repositories) [Reach Create repository only from the Repositories page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2741) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: `catalog.createComponent` can no longer be bound to the repository form, and a config that still binds it fails at startup. The Repositories page's `Create repository` button is unchanged.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Read delete_cluster's nothingLeft as removal done](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2753) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The `Delete cluster` dialog ends in a success message once nothing of the cluster is left, instead of a red refusal, also when opened on a cluster that is already removed.
- (agent-platform) [Show Delete only on clusters create_cluster made](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2745) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a cluster's page, `Delete` shows only for clusters made with `Create cluster`. Other clusters no longer offer it, where the dialog could only show a refusal.
- (app) [Skip TelemetryDeck on an empty app ID, log init failures](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2756) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: with an empty TelemetryDeck app ID, the portal logs one browser console warning and sends nothing, and a failed initialisation is logged instead of silently dropping all usage data.
- (app) [Offer the GitHub tabs only on a portal with a GitHub login](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2762) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On portals without a GitHub login, a component's page no longer shows the GitHub Actions and Pull Requests tabs, which only opened a `Login Required: GitHub` dialog that could never succeed.
- (backend) [Warn at startup when the telemetry app ID is empty](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2746) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: with TelemetryDeck enabled but `app.telemetrydeck.appID` empty, the backend logs a warning at startup, since the portal then sends no usage data at all.
- (backend) [Retry the database at start, exit on a failed boot](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2757) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: a backend started before its database retries for up to five minutes and turns ready once the database is up. A failed start exits instead of hanging unready, and the chart adds a `startupProbe`.
- (gs) [Keep the sidebar without a main auth provider](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2742) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a portal without a main auth provider, such as a local start with guest sign-in, the sidebar renders again instead of disappearing.
- (gs) [Open the cluster page of a cluster a HelmRelease installs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2754) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The page of a cluster installed by a Flux HelmRelease, such as one made with `Create cluster`, opens instead of showing a `NotFoundError`, with a new `Installed by` card showing the release, chart, version and status.
- (gs, kubernetes-react) [Secret store picker lists external-secrets.io/v1 stores and shows readable errors](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2768) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In templates such as RDS and ElastiCache, the secret store picker lists SecretStores and ClusterSecretStores again, and says why when it can't, instead of `[object Object]`.
- (scaffolder) [Refresh cluster tokens when a template is submitted](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2735) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Templates that apply resources to a cluster no longer fail with an expired token after a long form: the token is fetched on `Create`. A failed start shows an error on the review step, and `Create` works again.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update node.js to 173f125](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2755) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update codemirror](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2761) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update @giantswarm/k8s-types to v0.12.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2767) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- (deps) [Update dependency @bufbuild/protobuf to v2.15.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2733) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
